newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH INSURER AMPLICO SHOWS Q1 PLN 10.9 MLN NET.
newsitem.headline: POLISH INSURER AMPLICO SHOWS Q1 PLN 10.9 MLN NET.

text.p: Polish insurance firm Amplico Life had a net profit of 10.9 million zlotys in the first quarter of its 1997 financial year, which started on December 1, 1996, Amplico said in a statement on Monday.
In the January-March period of 1996 Amplico had a net loss of 0.4 million zlotys.

The company, which is 55-percent owned by the U.S.-based American Insurance Group (AIG) and 45-percent owned by Polish state-owned Bank Pekao SA this year changed the start of its financial year to December 1 from January 1.
Amplico's gros premium rose to 79.3 million zlotys in the first quarter of 1997 from 37.6 million in the first quarter of 1996.
The company's investments rose to 235.7 million zlotys in the first quarter from 98.2 million, the statement said.
